scenes.label: メモを変えたら、点検
scenes.action: One continuous memory structure: root guide, child guide connected to two detail cards, staged change, Letta inspection gate, Git saved-history dot. Show relation from frame0; no blank intro.

scenes.label: 案内がないと、止まる
scenes.action: L02 deletes the child guide. Its empty slot breaks both connections to detail cards; the same staged-change card stops at the gate. Git old dot stays, no new commit.

scenes.label: 案内を戻した、別の試行
scenes.action: Switch explicitly to separate recorded L03 trial. Same frozen input as L02 except child guide restored. Guide returns and connects details, staged change passes same gate, Git adds one saved-history dot. No live edit or rerunning agent.

scenes.label: 止まっても、変更は残る
scenes.action: Return explicitly to saved L02 result. Its blocked change remains in the left tray/stage, old Git dot stays. No data shredded or erased. Draw short reason marker pointing back to empty guide slot.

scenes.label: 点検と、正しさは別
scenes.action: Keep diagram; a checked structure is distinct from a question mark next to content/book. Inspection of shape is not truth or human approval. No live memory extraction or agent conversation.

scenes.label: 理由を見て、必要な所を直す
scenes.action: Hold the complete memory-to-inspection-to-save relationship and actual saved-record action for3s. Same physical illustrated objects, no fade to blank.

message: 記憶の変更を、図で点検する
source_author: Claude Opus5.5 authored original diagrams and absolute-time motion. Production removed narration and integrated silent playback; no new model attribution.
